object.name: evi_cross
object.digest: Reimplementation of MSP <o>cross~</o> filter as Likwitz-Riley
object.description: <o>evi.cross~</o> differs from MSP <o>cross~</o> in the following ways: <o>evi.cross~</o> is a steeper 4-pole crossover slope (<o>cross~</o> is a 3-pole slope), because 3rd order is not possible with flat summing Linkwitz-Riley. <o>evi.cross~</o> is a Linkwitz-Riley crossover which sums perfectly flat (whereas <o>cross~</o> is pure Butterworths and sums with a +3dB bump). <o>evi.cross~</o> remains stable under modulation. For a shallower 2-pole Linkwitz-Riley crossover @see <o>evi.crossover~</o>.

inlets.name: crossover
inlets.digest: The frequency at which to split the incoming audio into it's lowpass and highpass outputs.
